title: SLS V1 HUB TR
features:
Hitbox Expander (Olympus Gray Square): Enlarges your character's hitbox for easier ball contact. Adjustable size (10–50, default 25) with +5/-5 buttons. Toggle ON/OFF.
Speed Hack: Sets walk speed to 50 (much faster movement). Toggle ON/OFF.
Anti-Void: Teleports you back up (Y=20) if you fall below Y=-50. Toggle ON/OFF.
Goal Hitbox Expander: Makes goals (yours or opponent's) much larger. Adjustable:
Width: 40–180 (default 80)
Height: 20–60 (default 28)
Depth: 30–200 (default 60)
Forward Offset: 0–60 (default 15)
Goals become visible (semi-transparent, colored). Toggle ON/OFF.
Auto Goal: Automatically shoots the ball toward the opponent's goal at high speed (160). Targets correct goal based on your team. Toggle ON/OFF.
GUI: Modern red-black interface, minimizable bar, hover effects, Discord link copy button, game icon & avatar display.
